experiences.title: Freelance Software Developer
experiences.label: Remote
experiences.body: Building a restaurant management system and professional web products using Next.js, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and high-quality UI.
highlights: Building a restaurant management system (POS, KDS, Dashboard) using Next.js, Kotlin, and Spring Boot.
Developed professional wedding invitation web templates with high-quality UI.
Deliver full-stack features independently, from data modelling to polished frontend surfaces.
Keep production builds clean, fast, and ready for real client use from day one.
description: Working as a freelance software developer, I build full-stack products from design to deployment. Current focus is on a restaurant management system covering POS, KDS, and dashboard surfaces using Next.js on the frontend and Kotlin with Spring Boot on the backend.
Alongside the restaurant system, I have developed professional wedding invitation web templates with polished, high-quality UI — delivering production-ready work for real clients.
This role requires moving fast across the full stack while keeping code clean, interfaces sharp, and products genuinely ready to use.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
experiences.label: Tirana, Albania
experiences.body: Full-time engineering role building and optimizing a fiscalization system processing millions of records daily with Spring Boot and React.
highlights: Built and optimized a fiscalization system processing millions of records daily using Spring Boot and React, focused on performance.
Contributed to microservices architecture within a cross-functional Agile team.
Improved critical data paths and system responsiveness to handle high-volume production load reliably.
Collaborated across engineering, product, and operations to ship features in regular Agile cycles.
description: At AE Distribution I worked full-time as a software engineer, taking ownership of a fiscalization system that processed millions of records every day. The work demanded a strong focus on performance, reliability, and correctness at scale.

The stack was built around Spring Boot on the backend and React on the frontend. I optimized critical data paths, improved system responsiveness, and ensured the system remained stable under heavy load.

I also contributed to the company's microservices architecture as part of a cross-functional Agile team, collaborating across engineering, product, and operations to deliver features and improvements in regular cycles.

experiences.title: Web Developer & Event Organizer
experiences.label: Tirana, Albania
experiences.body: Part-time role building and improving website features for startups and representing the company at innovation events.
highlights: Built and improved website features to help startups showcase their growth.
Represented the company at events, engaging with entrepreneurs and startup stakeholders.
Translated startup product stories into clear, well-structured web experiences.
Gained direct exposure to early-stage product thinking and the bridge between tech and business.
description: At Protik Innovation Center I worked part-time as a web developer and event organizer, contributing to a hub that supports startups and entrepreneurs in Albania.
On the technical side, I built and improved website features that helped startups present their products and growth stories clearly to investors and partners.

Beyond development, I represented the company at events, connecting with entrepreneurs and startup stakeholders — giving me a strong sense of how product work and business goals align in early-stage environments.
